verdict.rationale: Skyvern's docs say self-hosted deployments run with your own LLM API keys or a local model (skyvern-docs-42, skyvern-docs-12, skyvern-docs-2), and organization settings let you choose models (skyvern-docs-43). A community user running it on their own OpenAI bill corroborates the bring-your-own-key setup (skyvern-comm-1). missing for 10: an explicit list of supported LLM providers or a configuration guide showing provider switching, and independent confirmation of non-OpenAI or local-model use.
